newsitem.title: USA: McDonough says Fed seeks sustained economic growth.
newsitem.headline: McDonough says Fed seeks sustained economic growth.

text.p: New York Federal Reserve Bank President William McDonough said the U.S. central bank's goal is to create sustained economic growth through price stability.
"The end we are seeking to bring about is sustained economic growth," McDonough told a banking conference on the National Payment System here.
"We at the central bank of the United states are very firm believers in growth but we very strongly believe that the way we can bring about growth is by bringing about price stability," he added.
McDonough also said monetary policy has a forward-looking bias that looks beyond current economic conditions.

"Central banking 101 is that monetary policy has long and variable lags ... We really have to be thinking about what the economy looks like 18 months, 24 months into the future with a very long-term goal of what we are seeking to achieve."
